screening.screening_rationale: Patient provides systematic, detailed, and coherent description of photo with multiple visual elements. Speech is well-organized, information-rich, and topically appropriate. No evidence of formal thought disorder.

Patient provides coherent, organized description covering subjects, interaction, clothing, and background. Normal speech disfluencies present but non-pathological. Maintains topical coherence and adequate information content throughout.

Patient provides systematic description of photo elements with coherent organization and topical focus. Minor speech disfluencies (unclear pronoun reference, sentence interruption) are non-pathological. Adequate visual information conveyed appropriately for task.
